summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate 4728bc00c490439134d4ddcc2782ad291effb5d9. The candidate test passes, but it does not construct the reported backup-only stub or call scheduler._prefetch_kvcache: this base defines backuped from live host_value, and host-leaf eviction frees the host value and removes the leaf. The candidate instead directly prefetches an absent suffix from a live L2 anchor and then directly prefetches the full key from root, with prefetch_threshold=1. Production sources are identical between candidate and base, so no justified production correction is possible on this prepared revision.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate test plus existing host-leaf eviction coverage on all collected configurations: 22 passed, 16 skipped. The passing candidate assertions show the suffix node is removed after host eviction and the complete case anchors at root; storage is invoked directly rather than through the scheduler.
Prepared interpreter reported torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, one available AMD Instinct MI355X device, capability (9, 5).
Candidate changes only one unit test and prior-job report artifacts; it changes no production source.

gpu_execution_evidence: The candidate and host-eviction tests executed with the prepared ROCm PyTorch environment, which detected one AMD Instinct MI355X. KV round-trip assertions compared actual device tensors and passed.
remaining_limitations: The reported NVIDIA L40S/CUDA 13 server/model workload was not reproduced because this prepared revision's UnifiedTreeNode.backuped property requires a non-null Full host_value, while _evict_host_leaf frees all host component values and removes the leaf. Therefore an evicted && backuped node cannot survive host eviction here. No unavailable architecture or missing weights were used to justify a speculative change. The original issue may describe an older/different tree implementation whose storage-backup state was independent of host residency; that implementation is not present at the recorded base.
